description: Renovate is the single owner of dependency updates for this repo; keep repository-level (UI) Dependabot disabled.

Covers: pnpm dependencies (package.json + pnpm-lock.yaml — this repo uses pnpm, there is no package-lock.json), Go modules under apps/backend, Gradle dependencies, GitHub Actions pins, and Docker base images (nginx, postgres, distroless, golang, actions-runner).
The packageManager field (pnpm) is updated by the npm manager; Nx and Angular packages are grouped via the monorepo presets that config:recommended pulls in.
The @jdw/* libraries are private workspace packages, versioned in-repo by nx release and never published to any registry.
libs/frontend/shared/ui declares @jdw/frontend-shared-util as a pinned peerDependency, so Renovate resolves it against npm, fails, and reports a repository problem on the dependency dashboard.
